## Files

An app is a folder. The root app is `examples/my_own_app/`; modules live in `modules/<name>/` and have the same layout (recursive). Never edit `.generated/`; it is hidden.

```
app.yaml                         name, description, version, state: initial values
app/
  actions/*.dart                 actions, one per file, its tests in main() below it
  models/*.yaml                  models and enums, one per file (state.yaml: the state)
  models/sample.dart             sample states for tests: sample()
  views/
    navigation.yaml              routes (optional; without it the app is MainPage)
    pages/*.yaml                 what routes open: MainPage, sheets, dialogs
    components/*.yaml            one widget per file
    style/*.yaml                 design tokens (optional)
    style/images/                image assets
    values/*.dart                values computed from state, one per file, its tests in main() below it
    labels/<language>.yaml       the app text, pure strings (en.yaml, pt_br.yaml)
modules/<name>/                  modules (same layout)
.state/                          runtime state (never commit)
```

Naming: files are `this_case.dart` / `this_case.yaml`; keys, functions, models and labels are `thisCase`; pages and components are `ThisCase`. A file is named after what it holds: `app/views/components/example_slide.yaml` holds `ExampleSlide:`, `app/views/values/step_1_state.dart` holds `step1State`, `app/models/sample.dart` holds `sample()`. Every `.yaml` file contains exactly one top-level key; files are not merged, and names must not repeat across files.

| Path | Holds |
|---|---|
| `app.yaml` | `name`, `description`, `state:` initial values. |
| `app/actions/*.dart` | `Future<void>` functions that change the state with `emit(StateDelta(...))`. One public action per file. |
| `app/models/` | Models and enums, one per file. The reserved `state` model lives in `app/models/state.yaml`. |
| `app/views/navigation.yaml` | `initial:` and `routes:` (pages, bottom sheets, dialogs) actions open with `core.navigator`. Optional. |
| `app/views/pages/*.yaml` | What routes open (`MainPage:`, `WaitlistDialog:`). Without navigation.yaml, `MainPage` is the app. |
| `app/views/components/*.yaml` | One widget per file (`Hero:`, `TaskList:`, ...). |
| `app/views/style/` | Design tokens, one group per file: `theme`, `fonts`, `icons`, `colors`, `radius`, `spacing`, `sizes`, `typography`. Optional; a module without it inherits the theme. See `reference/style.md`. |
| `app/views/style/images/` | Image assets. |
| `app/views/values/*.dart` | Functions that compute a value for the UI from the state. One public value per file. |
| `app/views/labels/<language>.yaml` | The app text: `en:` then `key: text`, one file per language (`en.yaml`, `pt.yaml`, `pt_br.yaml`), the same keys in each (a missing one shows the default language, `en`). Pure strings; values join them with state. |
| Tests | In the same file as the action or value they test, in a `void main() { test(...); }` below it. The tool ignores `main()` and leaves it out of the compiled program. |
| `app/models/sample.dart` | Sample states: `final app = TestApp();` (runs actions and values through the compiled program) and `State sample(...)`. |
| `modules/<name>/` | A module. Embed it with `module: <name>`: it runs with its own state, actions and values (it can't see the parent's, and vice versa). |
| `.state/` | Runtime persisted state, written by the engine. Never commit. |

Images go in `examples/my_own_app/app/views/style/images/` (`src: examples/my_own_app/app/views/style/images/x.jpg` or `x.svg`), for every app.

## Types

In `app/models/<name>.yaml` (one parent per file):

| Type | Dart | state.yaml value |
|---|---|---|
| `string` | `String` | `"text"` |
| `boolean` | `bool` | `true` / `false` |
| `number` | `num` | `3`, `2.5` |
| `datetime` | `DateTime` | `2026-11-05` or `2026-11-05T10:30:00` |
| `list(t)` | `List<T>` | a YAML list |
| `t?` | `T?` | may be omitted or `null` |
| a model name | its class (`task` -> `Task`) | a map of its fields |
| an enum name | its enum (`filter` -> `Filter`) | one of its values |

```yaml
# app/models/task.yaml
task:                 # model -> class Task
  title: string
  note: string?
  tags: list(string)

# app/models/filter.yaml
filter: [all, open, done]   # enum -> enum Filter

# app/models/state.yaml
state:                # reserved -> class State
  tasks: list(task)
  filter: filter
```

Generated classes have mutable fields, a named-parameter constructor (`Task(title: ..., tags: [...])`) and `copyWith(...)`. Import them with `import '../../.generated/state.dart';` from app/actions/ (`../../../.generated/` from app/views/values/).

## Actions and values

```dart
Future<void> actionName(State state, [void Function(StateDelta) emit], [Core core], [Labels labels], [int index], [<type> value])
T valueName(State state, [Labels labels], [int index])   // returns a value for the UI
```

```dart
Future<void> addTask(State state, void Function(StateDelta) emit) async {
  state.tasks.add(Task(title: state.draft));
  emit(StateDelta(tasks: state.tasks, draft: ''));   // only what changes
}
```

- The first parameter is always `State`. Others are matched **by name**:
  - `emit` (`void Function(StateDelta)`, actions only): applies a `StateDelta`. Call it as often as needed (loading, then result).
  - `core` (`Core`, actions only): `core.api` and `core.navigator`, see below.
  - `labels` (`Labels`): the text from app/views/labels/ as getters (`labels.peopleOnTheList`), in the language shown; `labels.locale` is that language (`pt_br`), `labels.locales` all of them. Import `.generated/labels.dart` relative to the file.
  - `index` (int): position of the item inside a `listView`/`gridView` `itemBuilder`
  - `value` (String | bool | num | int | double): the new value from an input (see each widget's notes for its type)
- Actions never return a state. `StateDelta` (generated next to `State`) has every State field, all optional; set only the ones that change. Top-level fields are replaced whole, so for a list or model, change `state`'s copy and emit it (`StateDelta(tasks: state.tasks)`). A delta can't set a field to null.
- `state` is a fresh copy taken when the action starts; it does not see its own emits.
- Values return a primitive, a model, an enum, or a `List` of those (nullable allowed).
- Text that depends on state is a value that joins labels: `'${state.count} ${labels.peopleOnTheList}'`. Labels stay pure strings (no placeholders).
- Names must be unique across the app's actions, values and labels (each module is separate). Private helpers start with `_`.

## Core: api, navigator and locale

Import `../../.generated/core.dart` (from app/actions/).

```dart
Future<ApiResponse> core.api.get(String url, {Map<String, String>? headers})
Future<ApiResponse> core.api.post(String url, {Object? body, Map<String, String>? headers})  // non-String body is sent as JSON
ApiResponse: int status, String body, bool ok, dynamic json   // network error: status 0

Future<void> core.navigator.push(Routes.settings)   // completes when the route closes
Future<void> core.navigator.pop()                   // closes the page, sheet or dialog on top

Future<void> core.locale.set('pt_br')   // the whole app (modules too) in pt_br.yaml, saved; null: the device's language again
```

The language is the device's by default (Flutter's localization, among the root app's labels files). A language menu is a `dropdown` with `value:` a value returning `labels.locale`, `options: [{value: en, text: english}, {value: pt_br, text: portuguese}]` and `onChanged:` an action calling `core.locale.set(value)`.

```dart
Future<void> loadRate(State state, void Function(StateDelta) emit, Core core) async {
  emit(StateDelta(loading: true));
  final r = await core.api.get('https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD');
  final rate = r.ok ? ((r.json as Map)['rates'] as Map)['BRL'] : null;
  emit(StateDelta(loading: false, rate: rate is num ? rate : 0));
}
```

Don't await `push` when the action should keep going while the route is open.

### app/views/navigation.yaml

```yaml
initial: home                        # must be a page route
routes:
  home: MainPage                     # page (shorthand); the value is in app/views/pages/
  settings: {page: SettingsPage}
  rate: {bottomSheet: RateSheet}
  confirmDelete: {dialog: ConfirmDeleteDialog}
```

- Each route becomes a constant: `Routes.rate`. Sheets and dialogs size to their content and scroll if long; give them padding.
- Tab-style screens inside one page stay as state + `match` (see below); routes are for things that open on top.

## app/views/

`app/views/pages/*.yaml` holds what routes open (`MainPage` without navigation.yaml); `app/views/components/*.yaml` holds one widget per file; `app/views/labels/en.yaml` holds the text.

```yaml
# app/views/pages/main_page.yaml
MainPage:
  scaffold:
    appBar: {title: notes}   # a label
    body: NoteList           # a component
```

```yaml
# app/views/components/note_list.yaml
NoteList:
  listView: {data: noteList, itemBuilder: NoteTile, empty: noNotes}
```

```yaml
# app/views/components/note_tile.yaml
NoteTile:
  listTile: {title: noteTitle, onTap: openNote}   # value, action
```

```yaml
# app/views/labels/en.yaml
en:
  notes: Notes
  noNotes: No notes yet
```

- Every `.yaml` file has exactly one top-level key, named after the file: the model, page, component, style group or language it declares.
- A widget is a map with **one key**, its type: `text: {...}`.
- A string node is: a page or component (`ThisCase`), else a value (its result is shown as text), else a label, else literal text. Put text in app/views/labels/; the tool warns about literal text.
- Labels and values are referenced the same way, by key: `text: joinTitle`.
- Components take parameters: `.name` anywhere in a component (`color: .screen`, `child: .child`) is filled by the caller, which writes the component like a widget: `PhoneFrame: {screen: '#F4FAF5', child: {module: food}}`. Parameters are not declared; they are the `.name`s the component uses, their kind is the prop they fill, and all are required. Arguments are anything that prop takes (a value, a label, an action, a widget), resolved where the component is called; `text: .label` passes the caller's own parameter on. Pages have no parameters. INDEX.md lists each component's.
- `module: food` embeds the module `modules/food/` (its initial page). Use it anywhere a widget goes, e.g. as a `match` case. Module folder names are valid identifiers; use thisCase for new ones.
- Some widgets have a shorthand (shown below): `column: [a, b]`, `expanded: child`, `text: "Hi"`.
- Widgets with no required props are written with an empty map: `divider: {}`.

Prop kinds:

| Kind | Accepts |
|---|---|
| `node` | a page or component, a value, a label, an inline widget, or literal text |
| `nodes` | a list of nodes |
| `cases` | a map of value -> node |
| `action` | name of an action |
| `value` | name of a value (a function in app/views/values/) |
| `text` | a value, a label or a literal |
| `literal` | a literal (number, text, list, map) |
| `icon` | an icon name (see Icons) |
| `color` | a color (see Colors) |
| `inline` | another widget's properties, written inline |
| `module` | name of a module (a folder in modules/) |

## Widgets

One line per widget: what it is and its props. Details (prop kinds, notes, shorthand) in `reference/widgets/<name>.md`; open one only when the line isn't enough.

| Widget | What | Props |
|---|---|---|
| `scaffold` | A page: app bar, body, floating button and bottom navigation. | appBar, body, floatingActionButton, bottomBar |
| `appBar` | Top bar of a page. | title, actions, backgroundColor |
| `column` | Vertical list of children. | children, spacing, mainAxisAlignment, crossAxisAlignment (shorthand `column: [a, b]`) |
| `row` | Horizontal list of children. | children, spacing, mainAxisAlignment, crossAxisAlignment (shorthand `row: [a, b]`) |
| `stack` | Children layered on top of each other. | children, alignment (shorthand `stack: [a, b]`) |
| `wrap` | Children that wrap onto new lines. | children, spacing, runSpacing, alignment (shorthand `wrap: [a, b]`) |
| `expanded` | Fills the remaining space inside a row or column. | child, flex (shorthand `expanded: child`) |
| `spacer` | Flexible empty space inside a row or column. Write `spacer: {}`. | flex |
| `center` | Centers its child. | child (shorthand `center: child`) |
| `padding` | Space around a child. | child, all, horizontal, vertical, left, right, top, bottom |
| `sizedBox` | Fixed-size box or empty space. | width, height, child |
| `container` | A box with padding, margin, background color, border, size and rounded corners. | child, padding, margin, color, radius, width, height, borderColor, maxWidth |
| `responsive` | Shows `wide` when the available width reaches `breakpoint`, else `narrow`. Use it to switch a row of columns to a stack on phones. | narrow, wide, breakpoint |
| `card` | A surface with a hairline edge. Tappable with `onTap`. | child, padding, color, onTap (shorthand `card: child`) |
| `scroll` | Makes its child scrollable. Do not put `expanded` directly inside. | child, horizontal (shorthand `scroll: child`) |
| `divider` | A thin line. Write `divider: {}`. | height, color |
| `module` | Embeds a module from `modules/<name>/`: its initial page, with its own state, actions and values. It inherits the theme unless it has a style/ folder. Its routes (pages, sheets, dialogs) open over the whole app, unless `contained: true`: then it gets its own navigator and they open inside its box (a phone frame), which must have a bounded size (e.g. inside `expanded`, not `scroll`). | name, contained (shorthand `module: food`) |
| `match` | Shows the case matching a value (e.g. the current page). Falls back to `default`. | value, cases, default |
| `navigationBar` | Bottom navigation. Put it in `scaffold.bottomBar`. | destinations, selected, onSelected |
| `text` | Text. | value, spans, style, align, maxLines (shorthand `text: "Hello"`) |
| `icon` | An icon. | name, size, color |
| `image` | An image (PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or SVG) from a URL (http...) or an app file. Put app files in `examples/my_own_app/app/views/style/images/` and use the path: `src: examples/my_own_app/app/views/style/images/logo.svg`. | src, width, height, fit, radius |
| `avatar` | A round avatar with an image or short text (initials). | text, image, radius, color |
| `marquee` | A row of children that scrolls sideways in a loop, like a news ticker. Still (and scrollable) when the device asks for reduced motion. | children, spacing, speed (shorthand `marquee: [a, b]`) |
| `progress` | Progress indicator. Without `value` it spins forever. | value, circular |
| `listView` | Scrollable list. `itemBuilder` is built once per item of `data`. | data, itemBuilder, empty |
| `gridView` | Scrollable grid. `itemBuilder` is built once per item of `data`. | data, itemBuilder, empty, columns, spacing, aspectRatio |
| `listTile` | A list row. | title, subtitle, leading, trailing, onTap |
| `if` | Shows `then` when the value is true, else `else`. | condition, then, else |
| `textField` | Text input. | value, hint, label, multiline, onChanged, onSubmitted |
| `checkbox` | Checkbox. | value, onChanged |
| `toggle` | On/off switch, optionally with a label. | value, label, onChanged |
| `slider` | Pick a number in a range. | value, min, max, divisions, onChanged |
| `dropdown` | Pick one option from a list. | value, options, hint, compact, onChanged |
| `choiceChip` | Selectable chip. | label, selected, onSelected |
| `iconButton` | Icon that runs an action. | icon, tooltip, color, onPressed |
| `filledButton` | Primary button. | text, icon, onPressed |
| `outlinedButton` | Secondary button. | text, icon, onPressed |
| `textButton` | Low-emphasis button. | text, icon, onPressed |
| `elevatedButton` | Raised button. | child, onPressed |
| `floatingActionButton` | Floating action button. | icon, child, onPressed |
| `tappable` | Makes any child tappable. | child, onTap |

## Interpreter rules

Actions and values run in dart_eval. `tool/check.sh` reports violations.

- Type closure parameters: `tasks.where((Task t) => t.done)`, not `(t) => ...`.
- Don't interpolate ints from `DateTime` getters (`'${d.month}'`). Use `toIso8601String()`.
- Only `dart:` imports and the app's own files (a module can't import its parent's).
- An app's files are bundled together, so private helper names must be unique across its files.
